Name: (CP) Darker Debris
Author: skeltom
Description:
This is just a simple overlay for the debris, I guess you would call it. Wood, stone and plants. I made this mod for my personal use to better match
DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour but i assume it could be used with other mods as well. I don't know enough about this stuff to inform about compatibility
with anything else.

If you haven't checked out her mod yet you should [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]

Manifest.Name: Darker Debris
Manifest.Description: A darker recolor of the wood,stone and fiber plants.
Manifest.Author: Skeltom
